title: Battle of Bulgnéville
summary: The English Wikipedia article "Battle of Bulgnéville", at revision 1370435548, opens: "The Battle of Bulgnéville was fought on 2 July 1431. The battle was fought between two cousins, René I d'Anjou and Antoine de Vaudémont, over partition of the Duchy of Lorraine after the death of Duke Charles II. Although René was defeated and captured, the result was reversed by diplomatic means in the years following." That is the article's account and not yet this atlas's; nobody has read this record, and review.html is where somebody does. Wikidata item Q690244, imported by tools/import/wikidata.mjs. The item's own description reads "1431 battle". Everything here is copied from the item's own fields and nothing in it is this atlas's account of the thing: that is still to be written, and review.html is where somebody writes it.
